name: synthetic-peptide-reconstitution-benchmark-v0-1-0
description: Twelve deterministic synthetic cases for testing unit-safe peptide reconstitution calculations. The default target is expected_volume_ml; the cases cover mass concentration, molar concentration, mixed mass units and explicit molecular masses. The data are generated examples, not customer, clinical, batch or instrument data. Unit spellings use ASCII-safe OpenML nominal values: ug maps to µg and ug/uL maps to µg/µL.
creator: Peptido Mexico Open Science
citation: Peptido Mexico Open Science (2026), Synthetic peptide reconstitution calculation benchmark v0.1.0, DOI: 10.6084/m9.figshare.33213873.v1
